definitions.gloss: medical examination and treatment, clinical practice
definitions.explanation: The combined act of examining a patient and providing treatment. Covers the whole process of a doctor seeing a patient, from diagnosis through treatment. Used broadly for medical consultations and clinical work.

examples.japanese: {午後|ごご}の{診療|しんりょう}は{三時|さんじ}からです。
examples.english: Afternoon consultations start from three o'clock.

examples.japanese: この{病院|びょういん}は{土曜日|どようび}も{診療|しんりょう}している。
examples.english: This hospital also sees patients on Saturdays.

examples.japanese: {診療|しんりょう}{時間|じかん}が{終|お}わっていたので、{救急|きゅうきゅう}{外来|がいらい}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: Since consultation hours were over, I went to the emergency outpatient department.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {診療|しんりょう}{時間|じかん}: consultation hours, office hours
- {診療|しんりょう}{科|か}: medical department/specialty
- {診療|しんりょう}{所|じょ}/{診療|しんりょう}{所|しょ}: clinic, medical office
- {外来|がいらい}{診療|しんりょう}: outpatient care
- {診療|しんりょう}{報酬|ほうしゅう}: medical fees (insurance-based reimbursement)

USAGE:
{診療|しんりょう} combines {診|しん} (examine) and {療|りょう} (treat), covering the full scope of a medical visit. Signs reading {診療|しんりょう}{中|ちゅう} (currently seeing patients) and {診療|しんりょう}{時間|じかん} (consultation hours) are seen at every clinic in Japan. The term is neutral and formal, appropriate for signs, forms, and general discussion of medical services.
